title: Third-order relativistic many-body calculations of energies, transition rates, hyperfine constants, and blackbody radiation shift in 171Yb+
read: Table I and energy/matrix-element method sections
scope: Direct Yb II benchmark; separate E2, E3, B1, B2 and Lamb shift. Printed NIST absolute zero is historical.

title: Correlation effects in Yb+ and implications for parity violation
read: Table I, II, V, VI; Sections II A and III A/B; orbital construction and convergence
scope: Direct Yb II second-order/linearized SD all-order/15-electron CI contrast. MBPT(HO) uses chosen Coulomb screening coefficients; it is separate from ab initio SD.

title: Calculation of nuclear-spin-dependent parity nonconservation in s-d transitions of Ba+, Yb+, and Ra+ ions
scope: Yb+ uses second-order correlation potential and Brueckner orbitals; Table I unscaled binding energies are separated from Table II empirical rescaling.

title: Electronic spectra of ytterbium fluoride from relativistic electronic structure calculations

scope: Use its explicit atomic Yb+ benchmark, not molecular YbF energies. EOM/IP and EA reference sectors and IH main/intermediate spaces affect accuracy.

scope: Formalism and Hg+ benchmark; proposed transfer to Yb+ is an inference, not a demonstrated Yb+ accuracy result.
